137.0359998 1.2 TRIGONOMETRY
Trigonometry commonly encountered in physics is covered, including polar
coordinate transformations and trigonometric identities; systems of equations
involving trig functions are also reviewed below. The law of cosines and
transcendental equations involving trigonometric equations are also discussed.

section, we review some of the most basic and essential properties of complex
numbers required for physics and differential equations.
